page_title: VIL 4-0 RAY | Villarreal v Rayo Vallecano 01/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Iosu Galech is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+3' It looks like Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) saw red with that tackle. Iosu Galech won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
90' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) takes a mid-range free kick and his stunning strike crashes against the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.

87' Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the roof of the net. Luiz Junior guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
86' Villarreal keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.

83' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) probably spotted the goalkeeper off his line, but he misdirected his long-range shot as it went a few yards over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
81' One of the Rayo Vallecano players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul.
79' Here comes a substitution. Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) is brought on as a substitute for Pedro Diaz.
79' It is time for a substitution. Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) is on for Alemao.
77' Marcelino prepares a substitution. Nicolas Pepe is replaced by Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal).
76' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Dani Parejo (Villarreal) is coming onto the pitch as Santi Comesana cannot continue after picking up an injury.
73' A player from Rayo Vallecano commits a rough challenge. Iosu Galech blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
73' The Villarreal players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
66' Inigo Perez decides to make a substitution. Jorge de Frutos will be replaced by Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano).
66' The substitution has been made. Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) has replaced Alvaro Garcia.
66' That will be all from Isi Palazon who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Fran Perez (Rayo Vallecano).
65' 4 - 0 Goal! Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 4:0.
64' Here is a change. Gerard Moreno is going off and Marcelino gives the last tactical orders to Ayoze Perez (Villarreal).
63' Substitution. Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Alberto Moleiro walks off.
61' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Villarreal players have a reason to celebrate!
60' Wait! Referee Iosu Galech has indicated he is going to review the Villarreal goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
58' 3 - 0 Santi Comesana (Villarreal) receives a brilliant pass inside the box from Alberto Moleiro, and he beats the goalkeeper with a low accurate shot into the middle of the goal. He makes it 3:0.

56' 2 - 0 Goal! Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom right corner. Augusto Batalla had no chance of reaching it. The score is 2:0.
54' Nobel Mendy (Rayo Vallecano) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
53' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) squandered a huge opportunity from inside the 6-yard box. He blazed it high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
49' Rayo Vallecano will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
47' Rayo Vallecano control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
47' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) swings in a cross from the corner, but Luiz Junior reads it well and gathers the ball.
46' Substitution. Georges Mikautadze leaves the pitch and is replaced by Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Villarreal).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+1' The end of the first half.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Rayo Vallecano.
42' Some patient build-up play from Villarreal as they look to unlock the defence.
41' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Luiz Junior intercepts the ball.
38' A pass from Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) is intercepted by Luiz Junior and the move breaks down.
38' Rayo Vallecano are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
37' A long pass, executed by Nobel Mendy (Rayo Vallecano), missed the precision to reach his teammates. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Villarreal.
36' Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
34' Renato Veiga (Villarreal) sends a long ball in, but Augusto Batalla comfortably gathers the ball.
33' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) unleashes a shot, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
33' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!

32' Rayo Vallecano players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.
31' Augusto Batalla leaps to intercept the corner kick from Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal).
31' The ball is cleared after Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
29' 42:58 – the ratio of ball possession.
29' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano).

28' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity. It will be a corner kick for Rayo Vallecano.
28' Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
27' A long pass, executed by Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano), missed the precision to reach his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
26' Rayo Vallecano take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
26' Iosu Galech sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
24' The Villarreal players halt their celebrations as referee Iosu Galech makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

22' 1 - 0 Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) displayed brilliant individual skill before blasting in a shot from inside the box. His terrific effort went straight into the bottom left corner, via a ricochet off the post. Augusto Batalla had no chance. The score sheet now reads 1:0.
22' Wonderful movement by Villarreal. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
21' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.

19' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) receives a reproachful look from Georges Mikautadze. He latches on to his pass, but the effort from the edge of the box sails well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
19' Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
18' The Rayo Vallecano players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
16' Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) latches on to a pass inside the box and strikes the ball to the middle of the goal, but one of the defending players makes a goal-line clearance.
15' A pass by Alemao (Rayo Vallecano) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
14' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Luiz Junior, who smothers the ball.
12' Alemao (Rayo Vallecano) stoops for a header low near the left post from a cross, but the goalkeeper pulls off a great save!
10' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
9' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) sends the corner into the box, but Luiz Junior intercepts it and averts the threat.
9' Rayo Vallecano are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.
6' The Rayo Vallecano players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
5' Renato Veiga (Villarreal) finds Juan Foyth with a nice pass so he can go on towards the goal.

4' The opposition back off Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal), who needs no second invitation to shoot from inside the box. It's a decent effort low towards the middle of the goal, but Augusto Batalla denies him with the save.
3' The corner is swung in but Villarreal can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
2' Rayo Vallecano are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
1' The Villarreal players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession.
